name: Greater Malaysia — data feed
description: A machine-readable index of live tools and verified data about Malaysia, built on official open data. Every dataset links to its official primary source.
license: Figures derive from official open data; cite the primary source listed per item.

datasets.description: Share of working-age Malaysians using AI tools, with SEA and global comparison (147 economies), updated roughly quarterly. Malaysia: 18.3% (H1 2025) → 21.8% (Q1 2026).
datasets.source: Microsoft AI for Good Lab — AI Diffusion Report (MIT-licensed open data)

datasets.description: Malaysian general election results 1959–2022 — winning coalition's share of Parliament, GE15 seats by coalition, turnout. Plus GE16 timing (deadline 17 Feb 2028) and how the system works (222 seats, 112 majority).
datasets.source: Election Commission of Malaysia (SPR); Federal Constitution; open-data archives (Thevesh, Tindak Malaysia)

datasets.description: Federal government spending, revenue and deficit — operating vs development expenditure, and the breakdown of where the money goes.
datasets.source: Ministry of Finance Malaysia via data.gov.my

datasets.description: Daily Islamic prayer times by JAKIM zone for cities across Malaysia.
Weekly RON95, RON97 and diesel retail prices (RM/litre) in Malaysia.
Live MYR exchange rates against major currencies, ECB reference rates.
Consumer Price Index inflation, overall and by category.
Median and mean monthly salary by sex, education and sector.
Median household income, poverty and the B40/M40/T20 split by state.
datasets.source: DOSM Household Income Survey via data.gov.my

datasets.description: Unemployment rate, participation rate and labour force, 2010–present.
datasets.source: DOSM Labour Force Survey via data.gov.my
